visualCharacteristics.purpose: Toolbar above a listing: result count, sort select and reset-filters link

contentPattern.structure: One row: result count text (e.g. 29 results) | list of sort options (linked items navigate; plain items set ?sort= and fire results-toolbar:sort) | reset link (e.g. Reset Filters). Any cell may be omitted

reuseGuidance: Reuse for the same content pattern; background colour comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black).
